subject: Clarify invoice remit entity, VAT/resale handling & payment terms for Order Form - NovaHealth
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice remit entity + tax handling questions for Redwood order form

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the draft order form. Procurement and legal at NovaHealth are reviewing — a couple of items we need clarified before we can proceed:

1) Invoice remit / remit-to entity: The draft invoices Redwood sent were addressed to Redwood Inference LLC (US). Our AP team needs invoices addressed to NovaHealth USA Inc (our US operating entity) for payment. Can Redwood confirm whether invoices can be routed to that entity or if an alternate remit flow is required?

2) Taxes / resale: For our EU subsidiaries we need to confirm how VAT/resale will be handled. Will Redwood invoice our local EU entity (with VAT) or will Redwood invoice the US entity and we handle local VAT via reverse-charge? If you require tax residency certificates to avoid VAT, please let us know the evidence format.

3) Payment terms: Our standard is net30 but we can accept net45 on larger contracts. The order form currently has net45. Will Redwood consider net30 for a pilot?

Attaching our draft PO for reference. Let me know who on your side I should loop in.

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaHealth

Attachments: Draft_PO_NovaHealth.pdf (attachment stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice remit entity + tax handling questions for Redwood order form

Samantha — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the PO. Looping in Ben (commercials), Marissa (legal handoff) and Jordan (finance) to confirm.

Quick answers up front:
- Remit entity: We can route invoice remittance to NovaHealth USA Inc. We typically issue invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. but can set the remit-to to the entity you provided. If NovaHealth prefers the invoice "billed to" name to be NovaHealth USA Inc, we will need to confirm the billing/legal entity mapping with our accounting team.
- VAT/resale: Our standard approach is to invoice the local NovaHealth entity in-region when we have a valid local tax registration or VAT number on file. If you want Redwood to invoice the US entity and you handle reverse-charge, we will need an EU tax residency or reverse-charge declaration from your side. Please send the certificate and we will route per your instruction.
- Payment terms: We can discuss net30 for the pilot. Commercially, our standard is net45 for enterprise commitments; we can offer net30 at a small premium or an early-payment discount. Ben — can you confirm what concession (if any) we can offer for a six-month pilot?

Action items:
- NovaHealth: share W-9 / VAT certs where applicable; confirm billed-to vs remit-to preference.
- Redwood: Ben to confirm early-pay discount or net30 pricing delta; Marissa to prepare redlines to the order form reflecting remit-to and VAT evidence clause.

I attached an annotated order form (Redwood_OrderForm_NovaHealth_v2.docx) with initial redlines for your review.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_NovaHealth_v2.docx (attachment stub); Tax_Evidence_Request_Template.pdf (attachment stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaHealth order form - routing + min-commit impact

Ben / Marissa — following up with a quick internal note so legal/finance are aligned before I reply to Samantha:

Context (summary of asks):
- NovaHealth wants invoices routed/billed to NovaHealth USA Inc (remit-to).
- They asked about VAT/resale handling for EU entities and documentation required.
- They prefer net30 but currently we propose net45.

Commercial considerations:
- Minimum commit: if we move to net30 without any pricing change, we increase DSO exposure. For a 6-month pilot (~$120k ARR run rate), suggest either: 1) keep net45 OR 2) offer net30 + 1% price uplift OR 3) net30 with 2% early-pay discount. Thoughts?

Legal redline asks (Marissa):
- Add clause: "Tax Evidence and Invoicing" — Redwood will invoice the NovaHealth entity designated in the order form. If Customer requests alternate invoicing (e.g., US entity invoices for EU consumption), Customer must provide valid tax residency or reverse-charge documentation prior to the first invoice.
- Add operational note on remit-to vs billed-to fields and PO acceptance to avoid PO mismatch at AP.

Jordan: will need a short SOP for finance to accept remit-to changes and map payments to the correct entity. Can you draft the mapping template we use for other customers?

I plan to respond to Samantha by EOD with proposed language and options.

Thanks,
Kim

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: legal@novahealth.com, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2025-08-21T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice remit entity + tax handling questions for Redwood order form

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and the annotated order form. A few updates from our side after internal review:

1) Attached is an updated PO that lists NovaHealth USA Inc as the billed-to entity and includes our finance contact for remittance.
2) For EU subsidiaries, NovaHealth prefers Redwood invoice the local EU entity where possible. If Redwood cannot invoice locally, we will provide the reverse-charge declaration and VAT registration numbers.
3) Payment terms: we can accept net45 for the initial pilot if Redwood can include a 1% early-payment discount for invoices paid within 15 days. That helps us keep standard net30 process cost-neutral.

Please confirm if Redwood can accept the remit-to as listed on the attached PO and add the tax evidence clause you mentioned. If you can send a redline with the exact wording, we can circulate to legal and finalize.

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaHealth

Attachments: Updated_PO_NovaHealth.pdf (attachment stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice remit entity + tax handling questions for Redwood order form

Samantha — thanks, appreciate the updated PO and the flexibility on terms. Confirming next steps and our proposed final language:

1) Remit-to / billed-to: Redwood will set the invoice "billed to" and remit-to fields to the entity specified on the PO (NovaHealth USA Inc). Our accounting team will issue invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. but include NovaHealth USA Inc as the bill-to. Jordan will prepare a one-page mapping template for AP to ensure payment allocations do not delay reconciliation.

2) VAT/resale: Proposed clause (for redline):
"Tax evidence and local invoicing: Redwood will invoice the Customer entity designated in the Order Form. If the Customer requests Redwood to invoice a different entity (for example, a US entity for EU consumption), the Customer must provide valid tax residency documentation, VAT registration numbers, or a reverse-charge declaration prior to Redwood issuing the first invoice to that entity. Absent such documentation, Redwood will invoice the local Customer entity in the country of consumption. Customer remains responsible for any local VAT, withholding, or similar taxes unless otherwise agreed in writing."

3) Payment terms / discount: We can accept net45 as the documented payment term for this Order Form and will include an early-payment discount of 1% for invoices paid within 15 days. Ben: confirm that discount approval exists for this pilot (we discussed 1% early-pay in our internal thread).

4) Attachments & signature: I will circulate a DocuSign-ready redline of the order form that includes the tax-evidence language and the early-pay discount clause. Once you confirm, we will send for signature and have finance mark the remit-to mapping.

If that sounds good, Samantha, we will produce the redline and DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
